nodes.statement: A ResetActionInfo GET invokes the host reset-action information handler.
The handler proceeds only for a resolved system whose index is valid for the host-state service.
The reset-action handler enters the asynchronous AllowedHostTransitions lookup path.
getAllowedHostTransitions reads the host AllowedHostTransitions property and dispatches its callback.
The callback creates a local allowable ResetType value list.
The callback owns and mutates the local allowable ResetType list until it returns.
The callback initializes the list with ForceOff, PowerCycle, and Nmi before error disposition.
Missing-property errors append fallback reset types, while unexpected D-Bus errors take the internal-error branch.
An unexpected D-Bus error is propagated to the HTTP response as an internal error.
After recording an unexpected internal error, the callback returns before publishing Parameters.
Returning from the callback releases its local allowable ResetType list.
The unexpected-error test observes an Internal Server Error response instead of a ResetType parameter list.
The GetAllowedHostTransition tests distinguish unexpected errors from missing-property fallback behavior.

edges.statement: The GET route resolves and validates the requested system before reset-action handling.
A valid system index permits entry into reset-action information handling.
The handler requests AllowedHostTransitions through its D-Bus helper.
The D-Bus callback begins by creating the allowable ResetType list.
The newly created list remains local to and owned by the callback.
The callback populates its owned list with the three default reset types.
After defaults are installed, the callback classifies the D-Bus result and chooses fallback or error handling.
An error outside the missing-property cases causes the internal-error response path.
Recording the internal error is immediately followed by return from the callback.
Returning from the callback ends the lifetime of the local allowable-values resource.
The early return leaves the response in the observable Internal Server Error state.
The system test asserts the unexpected-error HTTP result and separately verifies fallback behavior.

disconfirming_checks.statement: An unexpected invalid_argument error must produce Internal Server Error, whereas a missing property must produce fallback ResetTypes.
The transition mapping test verifies the supported D-Bus transitions map to their declared Redfish ResetTypes.
